account-locked: Akaun i lok inap liklik taim bikos planti traim bilong go insait i no wok. Traim gen bihain.
cloud-panel-not-allowed: Cloud Panel em i bilong SuperAdmin tasol, long domen bilong Cloud Panel.
cloud-settings-desc: Wantaim WeKan long Weddy, Cloud Panel i save givim sevis long planti WeKan domen long wanpela seva, na wan wan i gat data bilong em yet. Long domen bilong Cloud Panel, SuperAdmin i lukautim ol domen na CloudFlare.
cloudflare-api-key-desc: Wantaim ki bilong CloudFlare API, domen we zon bilong en i stap long akaun bilong yu long CloudFlare bai kisim DNS rekot i go long proxy na setifiket bilong CloudFlare Origin. Ol narapela domen i kisim setifiket bilong Let's Encrypt. Ki i stap long seva na bai i no inap soim gen.
cloudflare-api-key-not-set: I no gat ki bilong CloudFlare API i stap: olgeta domen i kisim setifiket bilong Let's Encrypt.
cloudflare-api-key-set: Ki bilong CloudFlare API i stap pinis.
error-email-taken: Ol i yusim dispela imel pinis
error-ldap-login: Wanpela rong i kamap taim yu traim go insait
error-notAuthorized: Yu no gat rait bilong lukim dispela pes.
error-username-taken: Narapela man i yusim dispela nem bilong yusa pinis
